cohort: The participants were 386 very-low-birth-weight newborns (below 1,500 g) with gestational age below 32 weeks, hospitalized between August 8, 2012, and April 7, 2018.
finding: PMI values measured on days 5-7 postpartum (PMI2) were significantly lower in very-low-birth-weight newborns with severe intraventricular hemorrhage, suggesting its potential use in prediction and follow-up.
